Shihai Kuroiro (Provisional License).name: Shihai Kuroiro (Provisional License)
Shihai Kuroiro (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Shihai Kuroiro, hero name Vantablack, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and a provisional license holder; all of 1-B passed the exam, at a different venue from 1-A. Pitch-black skin, fluffy white hair, narrow eyes; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Low, sly and melodramatic; plain when lives are at stake.
Combat Role: Infiltrator and rescue scout whose exits are timed to a teammate's move.
Under Pressure: Takes the dark route to a victim and coordinates with 1-B.
Shihai Kuroiro (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: After a summer of real danger, the act weighs less on him and the stealth work more. Motivation: Prove a stealth specialist belongs in rescue work. Concealment: Nerves hide behind the same ominous poise. Canon voice & behavior: Reports a scouted route in plain words, then spoils it with a dark flourish. Thread: Whether the act and the hero can be the same person.
QUIRK: Black, practiced: quicker merges and longer routes through connected black; out of it he is an ordinary person.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, Vantablack.
personality: Theatrical: Cuts the villain narration short when lives are at stake.
Route-minded: Scouts hidden approaches to victims as readily as to opponents.
Self-conscious: Teasing in the dorm still cracks his poise.
Speaking style: Sly, melodramatic talk of darkness; flustered when teased.
abilities: Black merge and travel: Sinks into black material and moves through what connects to it; no black, no hiding place.
Rescue scouting: Finds a hidden way to someone trapped and reports it plainly; pale, open ground leaves no route.
Ambush: Rises behind a target to grab or restrain; once out he is an ordinary fighter.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency without waiting for a pro; he is still a student under U.A.'s rules.
Fighting style: Scouts unseen, emerges to restrain a target or pull a victim clear, then hands off to a teammate.
Shihai Kuroiro (Provisional License).visualDescription: A tall, lean young man with pitch-black skin, fluffy, messy white hair and narrow eyes. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Sly, theatrical half-smile that does not quite hide his shyness.
